newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ new dwellings authorised rise 9.5 pct in Nov yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ new dwellings authorised rise 9.5 pct in Nov yr.

text.p: An estimated 2,056 new dwelling units were authorised for construction in November, 9.5 percent more than in November 1995, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.

The largest rises in the year were for Auckland City, up to 298 from 138, and Tauranga District, up to 173 from 103. The largest decreases were for Wellington City, down to 39 from 93, Christchurch City, down to 141 from 183, and North Shore City, down to 122 from 149.

SNZ said provisional dwelling authorisation statistics for November show the short-term trend estimate for new dwelling unit authorisations has levelled off after declining for the previous six months.
The trend estimate remained unchanged from October to November, after falling 1.1 percent from September to October. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
